title: Quality issues
text:
Quality issues. I ordered two of these - one for my living room TV and the others as a hangout place for my cats in front of a bay window. Each had quality issues, and they were different for each of the two.

One had bubbles in the top surface of the "wood" shelf because some of the factory installed fasteners were either too long or torqued too much. Also, the metal legs had rust streaks. At first I thought this was part of the rustic look, but the second one had an even finish. Finally, on the first one one of the bolts would not line up.

The second one had a broken and bent piece of the metal mesh shelf, which I had to cut, then file down. It had two factory fasteners that actually broke the surface of the wood (or laminate) layer of one of the shelves. Finally, the two parts (there are actually four laminate and two metal mesh shelves that are connected to form three long shelves) did not totally line up. From a distance they look fine, but up close it imparts a cheap, shoddy look. Finally, two bolts were stripped, and it was real work lining many of them up.

The sad part is this could have been an outstanding product - other than the quality issues the assembly could have been a breeze (misaligned bolts and shelves aside), and it is sturdy. I'll give it that. And if the quality was there the value would be darn good too.

Personally I am not purchasing another product from this company. Caveat emptor.
